tools.name: civitai_search_models
tools.description: Search civitai.com for models (LoRA by default) and SHOW THE USER A PICKER: each result becomes a card with cached example images, base model, trigger words, download count and a Download button. Use this for any 'find / search / recommend a LoRA (or checkpoint) on civitai' request instead of running civitai.py by hand. Returns a numbered summary you can refer to; the user picks which one to download.

query.description: Search text, e.g. 'school uniform' or a character name. Do not put the base model in the text; use base_model for that.

base_model.description: Only models that have a version for these base models (the card then shows that version). Civitai names: 'SD 1.5', 'SDXL 1.0', 'Pony', 'Illustrious', 'NoobAI', 'Flux.1 D', 'Flux.1 S', 'Flux.2 D', 'Flux.2 Klein 9B', 'Anima', 'Krea 2', 'ZImageTurbo', 'ZImageBase', 'Qwen', 'Chroma', 'Wan Video 2.2 T2V-A14B' ...; common short forms (sd1.5, sdxl, pony, illu, noob, flux, qwen, z image, wan) are understood. Use it whenever the user names a base model / architecture.

types.description: Model type: LORA (default), Checkpoint, TextualInversion, LoCon, DoRA, Hypernetwork, Controlnet.

sort.description: Default is relevance; 'Most Downloaded' is a good choice for popular picks.

tag.description: Only models with this civitai tag.

nsfw.description: Include NSFW models; omit to use civitai's default.

cursor.description: Continue from a previous result's next_cursor.

tools.name: civitai_search_images
tools.description: Search images that people posted on civitai.com, with their generation data (prompt, negative prompt, sampler, steps, CFG, seed, checkpoint, LoRAs used), and SHOW THEM TO THE USER AS A GALLERY. Use it for: (1) images a given user made with a given LoRA / model ('what did user X make with this LoRA'): username + model; (2) every image a user posted ('show me user X's images'): username only; (3) community images of a model: model only. Each result carries a civitai image_id; to keep some as example images of an installed model, pass those ids to the Civitai Helper tool civitai_add_user_examples.

username.description: civitai username of the person who posted the images (as shown on civitai, without @).

model.description: The LoRA / model the images must use: a civitai model id or model page URL (a URL with ?modelVersionId= narrows to that version). For a LoRA installed locally, get its civitai model id / version id from Civitai Helper (civitai_local_model_info) or pass model_version_id.

model_version_id.description: Alternative to model: one civitai model version id.

nsfw.description: Highest NSFW level to include. Default X = everything including NSFW; pass None only when the user asks for SFW / safe images.

cursor.description: Continue from a previous result ('More images available: cursor=...').
